summary: D-FUTURE-04 Smart Clients List (editorial-sober variant C) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_clients_smart.py covering enriched payload, sort score_desc/name_asc, bucket filters (sellers/searchers/to_call_today), q-search, route-ordering regression (/clients/smart not caught by /clients/{cid}), POST /smart/refresh (executes + idempotent when cache full), and unauth 401. Regression: vanilla GET /api/app/clients still 200 (used by client edit form). Frontend /it/app/clients renders perfectly: banner ◆ visible, default bucket 'Tutti' active (stone-900), 4 client rows (2 buyers Luca/Andrea with score 95/92 ROVENTE + 1 MATCH pill, 2 sellers Giulia/Mario with — n/a + 0 MATCH dashed pill), italic stone-500 action hints, monochrome dots only — zero vivid colors (red/orange/green/amber/yellow tailwind classes not found). Filter Acquirenti → 2 rows, Tutti reset → 4. Sort 'Nome A→Z' re-fetched order: Andrea→Giulia→Luca→Mario. Click on row navigates to /it/app/clients/{id}. clients-refresh-ai-btn correctly absent because counts.ai_uncached_searchers=0 (all 2 searchers already AI-cached). All data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: clients_smart.py — clean separation: _enrich_client() / GET /smart / POST /smart/refresh. Mongo _id excluded everywhere via {'_id': 0} projections. Good.

clients_smart.py — _enrich_client is called twice on the same data (once for filtered list, once for counts). For 4 clients this is fine, but at 1000+ clients it'll double CPU. Minor optimization: compute enriched once, derive counts from it before applying bucket filter.

clients_smart.py POST /smart/refresh — runs gemini-3-flash in parallel via asyncio.gather with hard cap (limit<=50, default 10). 24h cache via lead_score_cache collection. Errors caught per-task so one failure doesn't fail the batch. Robust.
Route ordering verified: clients_smart_router mounted before clients_router so /smart isn't shadowed by /clients/{cid}. Tested explicitly (test_smart_route_not_treated_as_id).
ClientsPage.jsx — clean rewrite, ~320 lines, well below 700-line threshold. Separated subcomponents (TempPill, ScoreBox, MatchesPill, FilterPill, ClientRow) for readability.
ClientsPage.jsx — uses i18n for all labels (clients_smart.* namespace), AbortController on fetch, toast auto-dismiss at 4s. Refresh-ai-btn conditionally rendered only when uncached>0 (correct UX).
ClientsPage.jsx — sort dropdown re-triggers load() via useEffect[bucket,sort]. Search input requires explicit submit (form onSubmit) — consistent UX, no debounce churn.

ClientsPage.jsx — all 23 required data-testid attributes present: clients-page, smart-banner, bucket-filters, filter-pill-{all|to_call_today|rovente|caldo|tiepido|freddo|searchers|sellers}, clients-search, clients-sort, clients-new-btn, client-row-{id}, score-box, score-box-empty, temp-pill-{rovente|caldo}, matches-pill, matches-pill-zero, clients-smart-list, clients-loading, clients-empty, clients-smart-toast. clients-refresh-ai-btn correctly conditional.

Editorial-sober palette enforced: dot shades use bg-stone-900/700/400/300 only; pills bg-stone-100 + stone-200 border; active bucket stone-900/stone-50 (dark allowed per spec). DOM html-scan confirmed: NO red/orange/green/amber/yellow tailwind classes in the list.
Console: one transient '[OMNIA API] undefined canceled' message from AbortController during normal nav — expected, not a bug.

Minor i18n suggestion: 'Da chiamare oggi' bucket renders correctly but 'to_call_today' criterion only allows temperature in (rovente,caldo) AND matches_count>0 — currently 2 (matches counts['to_call_today']). Behavior matches PRD.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Reused existing 4 clients (Luca Bianchi buyer, Andrea Romano buyer, Giulia Verdi seller, Mario Bianchi seller) + 1 active property. lead_score_cache already has 2 entries (Luca↔property, Andrea↔property) from prior smoke tests, so refresh-ai-btn is correctly hidden. 0 new LLM calls consumed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_clients_smart.py (10 tests, ~1.5s, no LLM cost since cache is already warm). Frontend testid coverage on /it/app/clients matches PRD. To test the Refresh AI button, the cache needs to be invalidated — currently no DELETE endpoint exists for that, so manually delete docs from lead_score_cache or create a new searcher client without cache.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria met. Backend 10/10 pass + vanilla regression OK. Frontend renders editorial-sober palette flawlessly (zero vivid colors), all interactions work, all 23+ data-testids in place. Conditional refresh-ai-btn correctly hidden because counts.ai_uncached_searchers=0 (expected per PRD note in review_request).
